title: THE BAR LINES UP
why: Found by the whole-game bug hunt of 2026-10-08, on the 4K bar screenshot. At THE LAST POUR the small line under each drink (under Liquor and under Blotter) began a step to the right of the drink name above it, so each row had two left edges. The line now starts right under the name. The words are unchanged.
now: At the bar, the line under each drink now starts right under its name.
